changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Every purchase a user ever made, one row each, for the invested series (issue #244): stock lots, crypto lots and fund contributions, with the month they fall in as a real DATE so ordering is chronological. wallet_amount is the amount in the wallet's own currency, rate is that currency's stored rate (1 when it has no currency_rates row), and amount is wallet_amount restated in the rates-anchor currency the way holdings_valued defines it. Like the holdings views it keeps every lot, completed holdings included, because the series charts money put in, not money still held.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE VIEW finances.contributions_timeline AS SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, 'STOCKS'::finances.wallet_kind AS kind, date_trunc('month', stock_lots.lot_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, stock_lots.quantity * stock_lots.price AS wallet_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, stock_lots.quantity * stock_lots.price * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS amount FROM finances.stock_lots JOIN finances.stock_holdings ON stock_holdings.id = stock_lots.stock_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = stock_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, 'CRYPTO'::finances.wallet_kind AS kind, date_trunc('month', crypto_lots.lot_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, crypto_lots.quantity * crypto_lots.price AS wallet_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, crypto_lots.quantity * crypto_lots.price * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS amount FROM finances.crypto_lots JOIN finances.crypto_holdings ON crypto_holdings.id = crypto_lots.crypto_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = crypto_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, 'FUNDS'::finances.wallet_kind AS kind, date_trunc('month', fund_contributions.contribution_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, fund_contributions.amount AS wallet_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, fund_contributions.amount * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS amount FROM finances.fund_contributions JOIN finances.fund_holdings ON fund_holdings.id = fund_contributions.fund_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = fund_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency;
